data.rationale: The proposal has the same procedure and the same parameters (route, date) in the right order: open Planned Service Changes, search for and select the route, then pick a date. It is slightly less precise because it merges typing and selecting into one step and treats the date pick as always required, when the true workflow only picks a date if needed.
